title: Elemental Foundations
description: Helvant teaches from a tower he built himself, not a guild's coffers - there's no council behind him if you get something wrong, only him telling you afterward which mistake would have killed you fastest. He wants the four elements gathered and used, not admired: forge-fire in Dalhurst, lake-water in Millbrook, standing-stone earth at the Crossroads, hilltop air over Elder Moor, and three real fights won on nothing but what you learned from them.

objectives.description: Draw fire essence from the forge at Dalhurst's blacksmith
objectives.notes: Player must visit the blacksmith and interact with the forge

objectives.description: Draw water essence from Millbrook's lake
Draw earth essence from the standing stones at the Crossroads
objectives.notes: Ancient stones at the Crossroads hold earth magic

objectives.description: Draw air essence from the hilltop over Elder Moor
Kill three things with what you just learned, not a blade
objectives.notes: Player must use spells to kill enemies - tracked via combat manager

objectives.description: Tell Helvant what each element felt like when it worked

notes: Threat: none new - training, same as mage_01's shape, but privately funded rather than institutional. Giver motive: Helvant teaches alone, at his own risk and on his own dime, distinct from the Circle's budget-driven testing in mage_03/mage_04. Consequence: unwired, binary completion. Second quest in the chain.
